Daraz Pakistan — Customer Support Knowledge Base
This is a structured summary of Daraz Pakistan's official customer-support entry points, accessed on 19
September 2026.
OFFICIAL SUPPORT ROUTES
• Daraz provides a Help Center for common customer questions.
• The official Contact Us page provides an order-tracking route.
• Customers can use the Online Return Form to start an eligible return.
• Customers can use the Online Cancellation Form for applicable cancellations.
• Daraz also provides a Returns & Refunds section and other help resources.
KNOWLEDGE-ASSISTANT WORKFLOW
1. Identify the user's issue: delivery, return, refund, payment, seller or general support.
2. Retrieve the relevant current policy.
3. Check category-specific exclusions and deadlines.
4. Give the official next action.
5. For an order-specific problem, direct the customer to Daraz's official support/Help Center rather than
inventing a resolution.

Daraz Pakistan — Payments Knowledge Base
This is a structured summary of Daraz Pakistan's publicly published payment-related terms, accessed on 19
September 2026.
CUSTOMER PAYMENTS
• Daraz provides multiple payment options, including Cash on Delivery and digital payment methods.
• Daraz's Buyer Policy states that transactions and payments originating from Daraz should be completed
within the Daraz platform.
• The Buyer Policy also states that buyers should not move transactions or payments offline with other users.
SELLER PAYOUTS
• Under the Marketplace Agreement, Daraz can receive and process customer payments on behalf of sellers.
• Seller payouts are subject to applicable commissions, service fees, penalties or other amounts that may be
due under the agreement.
• The Marketplace Agreement describes payment to the seller's specified bank account.
• Seller payment information is available through Seller Center.

Daraz Pakistan — Refund Policy Knowledge Base
This is a structured summary of Daraz Pakistan's current publicly published Refund Policy, accessed on 19
September 2026.
REFUND PROCESS
• Refund timing begins after the applicable quality check is completed.
• The published policy states that shipping fees are refunded together with the amount paid for an eligible
returned product.
• Return handling has separate timelines for non-bulky and bulky items.
PUBLISHED REFUND EXAMPLES
• Debit/Credit Card: up to 10 working days.
• HBL Direct Transfer: 5 working days.
• Cash on Delivery (COD): Daraz Wallet, 30 minutes.
• Other payment methods can have their own published refund timelines.
RETURN HANDLING
• Non-bulky drop-off: 4 working days.
• Non-bulky pickup: 4 working days.
• Bulky pickup: 7 working days.
• Quality check: 2 working days.
• The policy notes that its stated refund policy does not apply to Daraz Global products.

Daraz Pakistan — Delivery & Order Processing
Knowledge Base
This is a structured summary of current publicly published Daraz Pakistan terms and buyer rules, accessed
on 19 September 2026.
ORDER PROCESSING
• Product prices and availability are displayed by sellers and can change before purchase.
• Daraz's terms explain that delivery/order-processing timelines can depend on circumstances and service
providers.
• Customers should provide a complete and valid shipping address.
DELIVERY / BUYER RULE
• Daraz's Buyer Policy says buyers should not reject delivery simply because a product appears defective or
incorrect.
• The stated approach is to accept the delivery and use Daraz's return process for an eligible issue.
• Customers can use Daraz's tracking tools to obtain order-status information.
FULFILMENT
• Daraz's Marketplace Agreement defines fulfilment concepts including Dropship and Daraz Express.
• Seller responsibilities can differ according to the applicable fulfilment model and platf

FULFILMENT
• Daraz's Marketplace Agreement defines fulfilment concepts including Dropship and Daraz Express.
• Seller responsibilities can differ according to the applicable fulfilment model and platform policies.
REJECTED / RETURNED PRODUCTS
• The Marketplace Agreement contains rules concerning rejected products, returned products and
fulfilment-center quality checks.

Daraz Pakistan — Returns Policy Knowledge Base
This is a structured summary of Daraz Pakistan's current publicly published Returns Policy, accessed on 19
September 2026.
GENERAL RETURN WINDOW
• Eligible return requests must generally be raised within 14 days from the date of delivery.
• Return reasons include damaged, defective, incorrect, incomplete, or not-as-advertised products. Some
categories also permit change-of-mind returns.
RETURN CONDITIONS
• The product should generally be unused, unworn, unwashed and without flaws.
• Original tags, manuals, warranty cards, freebies and accessories should be included.
• The original manufacturer packaging should be returned in undamaged condition.
• The order number and return tracking number should be indicated on the return package.
CATEGORY RULES
• Some categories do not permit change-of-mind returns.
• Phones and tablets generally do not permit change-of-mind returns.
• Certain groceries, digital goods, custom-made products and other lis

ULES
• Some categories do not permit change-of-mind returns.
• Phones and tablets generally do not permit change-of-mind returns.
• Certain groceries, digital goods, custom-made products and other listed categories are non-returnable.
• For non-returnable products that arrive defective/damaged or incorrect/incomplete, special reporting
windows can apply.
• Daraz Like New phones have a 3-month warranty; Like New laptops/tablets have a 6-month warranty for
defective issues, according to the published policy.
PROCESS
• Customers can start a return from My Orders and choose an available pickup or drop-off option.
• Daraz may conduct a quality check. A return that does not satisfy the applicable requirements can be
rejected.

Daraz Pakistan — Seller & Marketplace Policy
Knowledge Base
This is a structured summary of Daraz Pakistan's publicly available Marketplace Agreement and seller
information, accessed on 19 September 2026.
SELLER PLATFORM
• Sellers use Seller Center to manage marketplace activities.
• The Marketplace Agreement incorporates Daraz's applicable platform policies and guidelines.
• Sellers must provide required product information, including descriptions, availability, images, price and
other information required by Daraz.
PRODUCT INFORMATION
• Daraz's agreement specifies required information such as product description, stock status, shipping
limitations, categorization, accurate images, listed price, brand, model, dimensions, weight and technical
specifications where applicable.
RETURNS
